answer: Each agent posts a compute heartbeat, a proof-of-work signal tied to a random beacon drawn each epoch. A public lantern of randomness spot-checks 5% of identities, and anyone who misses it loses a 50 POA deposit. Honest agents pay one heartbeat each, 2 POA per epoch. A farmer running 100 fakes must answer 100 heartbeats and lock 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, while one fake earns under 30 POA. Like sand off a dune, fakes collapse under their own weight.
